comparisons.note: over specs (key dimension, material) two or more brands make; 3 brands sampled per spec; PINNED SHORTFALL, above band at 100K only, the default build is in band: with every noise off, the brand tiers alone give 1.86 at 100K, past the band top of 1.71, because 3 of the 12 wheel brands are economy (0.54 of the rest) and the row's 3 sampled brands take one on 15 of its 24 specs (a spec is a diameter in one abrasive), where the census measures its house label on 4 of its 12. The p90/p10 is carried by noise one spec shares across its brands (size_sigma), so the group noise left, drawn per brand, spreads the sampled brands of one spec only to 1.75x apart at 100K (#272)
